methodology.Fees: Net NAV growth from Spiko funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL/SPKCC/eurSPKCC and the SAFO Amundi Overnight Swap funds) distributed to holders, plus Spiko's annual management fee. The published NAV is already net of fees, so the management fee is added on top to reconstruct gross fees.
methodology.Revenue: Spiko management fees on assets under management: 0.25%/yr for the T-bill funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL), 0.10%/yr for the Cash & Carry funds (SPKCC/eurSPKCC), and 0.25%/yr for the Amundi Overnight Swap funds (SAFO/eurSAFO/gbpSAFO/chfSAFO). The Cash & Carry funds also charge a 25% performance fee above the risk-free rate (SOFR) that is not captured, since only the net NAV is published on-chain.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue — all management fees accrue to Spiko.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Net NAV growth from Spiko fund asset yields, distributed to token holders.

Fees.Assets Yields: Net fund NAV growth read from Spiko's canonical on-chain oracle (non-USD NAVs converted to USD via Chainlink FX feeds).
Fees.Management Fees: Annual management fee on assets under management: 0.25% for the T-bill funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL) and the SAFO funds, 0.10% for the Cash & Carry funds (SPKCC/eurSPKCC).

Revenue.Management Fees: Annual management fee on assets under management: 0.25% for the T-bill funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL) and the SAFO funds, 0.10% for the Cash & Carry funds (SPKCC/eurSPKCC).

ProtocolRevenue.Management Fees: Annual management fee on assets under management: 0.25% for the T-bill funds (USTBL/EUTBL/UKTBL) and the SAFO funds, 0.10% for the Cash & Carry funds (SPKCC/eurSPKCC).

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: Net fund NAV growth distributed to token holders.

constraints: Chain TVL, stablecoin value, protocol capital and vault capital are distinct metrics and must not be added into one total.
Parent and child protocol rows may overlap. Do not sum protocol rows to recompute chain TVL.
Protocol percentage changes can describe the whole multichain protocol; they are not labeled Stellar-specific.
Snapshot observation time is not an upstream market as-of timestamp. Current feeds without an explicit upstream timestamp keep upstream_as_of null.
All data is for research. Live protocol state and verified canonical token identity are required before financial planning or execution.
Provider predictions are stored as provider interpretations, not guaranteed returns or Nest safety ratings.
Absent values stay null; missing supply/borrow fields are not zero.
